name: Repair after a gate base merge merges
description: recensor reports one anchored finding on the pull-request head. The first repair caps the delay and the finding is re-reported on its changed line while develop moves on, so the forge reports BEHIND and the gate merges the base into the head itself; recensor re-reports the same finding on that base-merge head. The second repair fixes it, recensor approves, and the merge proceeds: the gate base merge used no repair attempt.
